sources.title: Steerable Cultural Preference Optimization of Reward Models
sources.snippet: We focus on the development of reward models for this purpose and present a novel reward model training algorithm (SCPO) that can incorporate diverse cultural preferences in a balanced manner.

sources.title: Steerable Cultural Preference Optimization of Reward Models
sources.snippet: Our method results in performance increases of the minority reward model of up to 7 points over the baseline model across two datasets, PRISM and GlobalOpinionQA, and across 7 countries. SCPO is up to 280\% more training data-efficient than full-data finetuning of reward models.

sources.title: Steerable Cultural Preference Optimization of Reward Models - AIPulseLab
sources.snippet: Researchers propose SCPO, a reward model training algorithm that balances cultural preferences across 7 countries, lifting minority-community scores by up to 7 points on PRISM and GlobalOpinionQA datasets while requiring 280% less training data than standard fine-tuning — a concrete step toward globally inclusive LLM alignment.
